line.s1_intro.text: Owl, a picnic by the lake! I brought the cups and you brought the plates.

line.s1_fox_cups.text: I have cups! Will every cup get a plate?

line.s1_owl_plates.text: Let's check. Put them in pairs: cup and plate, cup and plate.

line.s1_pair.text: Every cup stands by its plate. Look what is left.

line.s1_result.text: One cup has no pair. There are more cups than plates.

line.s1_owl_fewer.text: And there are fewer plates than cups. One is missing!

line.s1_daily.text: It's the same at home: does everyone at the table have a spoon? Make pairs and see what is left.

line.s2_signs.text: I know a sign that says which pile has more. It looks like a hungry mouth.

line.s2_more_sign.text: The mouth opens towards the pile with more. There are more cups, so it opens towards the cups.

line.s2_equal_sign.text: Now every cup has a plate. There are as many. This sign is two equal lines.

line.s2_owl_less.text: And if I take the cups away? One cup and three plates are left.

line.s2_less_sign.text: There are fewer cups. The mouth opens towards the plates, because there are more plates.

line.s2_summary.text: More, fewer or as many. The mouth always opens where there is more.

line.p_intro.text: Your turn. I'll show two piles and you point to the one with more.

line.p_which_more.text: Where is more? Point to it.

line.p_wrong_pair.text: Let's check in pairs. Look what is left without a pair.

line.p_signs_intro.text: Now the signs. Pick the mouth that fits, or the equal lines when there are as many.

line.p_which_sign.text: Which sign fits? Point to it.

line.p_wrong_sign.text: Not that one. The mouth opens where there is more. When there are as many, pick the equal lines.

line.a_owl_table.text: A home game: setting the table. I put out the plates, Fox the cups.

line.a_fox_check.text: Let's check in pairs: cup and plate, cup and plate.

line.a_owl_more_plates.text: One plate is left alone. There are more plates and fewer cups.

line.a_fox_which_sign.text: Which sign fits? There are fewer cups than plates. Point to it.

line.a_owl_right.text: Yes! The mouth opens towards the plates, because there are more plates.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to play this with you at home. When you set the table, check in pairs whether everyone has a plate and which there is more of!
